General Information

We collect personal data only when it is necessary for your activities on https://vikaretoucher.win/. In collecting, processing, and using your personal data, we strictly comply with all applicable legal regulations.

We will retain your personal data only for as long as is necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or to comply with applicable legal, regulatory, or reporting requirements.

Information We May Collect

To purchase a product or contact us, you will need to provide certain personal data. This information is collected via our feedback and order forms to complete your transaction and provide our services.

  • Email address;
  • Links to your Instagram or Facebook profiles.

In addition, https://vikaretoucher.win/ may collect technical data (such as cookies or IP addresses) when you:

Your Rights

  • deletion of your personal data.

If you no longer want us to process your personal data, or if you wish to restrict its processing, you may send a request to our email address: victoria.serhiyenko@gmail.com

Use of Cookies

The website https://vikaretoucher.win/ collects information about your behavior and visits to our pages to obtain usage statistics and measure website effectiveness. This allows us to personalize your experience and adapt our services to your interests. We do this using various technologies, including cookies. A cookie is a piece of data that a website sends to your browser, which is then stored on your computer for further identification by the website.

Most often, cookies are used to evaluate website effectiveness by measuring the number of visitors and the duration of their stay. They help identify the most popular topics and pages, ensuring ease of navigation and a better user experience without collecting personal information. Cookies may also be used to personalize your experience based on your previous interactions and preferences. Over time, this information helps us improve our services.

Cookies are typically divided into session and persistent cookies. Session cookies help you navigate the website efficiently by ensuring that information requested during a session does not need to be re-entered. These cookies are stored in temporary memory and are deleted when the browser is closed. Persistent cookies save user settings for current and future visits; for example, they simplify website authorization by remembering your credentials.

Persistent cookies are stored on your computer’s hard drive or mobile device and are activated when you open your browser. We use them to store information such as your language and country preferences. If you wish to decline cookies or be notified when they are being used, please configure your web browser settings. However, please note that if you disable all cookies, some services and features of the website may not function correctly.
